angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 2,999,349 km at 130.77 pc = 0.31 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.6470 +/- 0.0255 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 130.77 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 4.311 (4.224 to 4.399) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 2,999,349 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.770 (1.730 to 1.810) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5200 +/- 5.6 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4281180283478682496: teff_gspphot 5200.4404 K (16th-84th percentiles 5194.238-5205.4277), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4281180283478682496: teff_gspphot 5200.4404 K (16th-84th percentiles 5194.238-5205.4277), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kaveh.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.417, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 175541 (pscomppars): spectral type G8 IV, from Johnson et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...665..785J/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 175541 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.07 dex, from Johnson et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...665..785J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 175541 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.934, from Johnson et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...665..785J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 175541 (pscomppars): age 1.9 Gyr, from Johnson et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...665..785J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 175541 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.9 km/s, from Johnson et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...665..785J/abstract)
